scope: The Office divin subsection of the French source index (not the separately enumerated Temporal, Sanctoral, Mass proper or liturgical-document indices).
extraction_method: Manual transcription and structured classification from publicly visible index; entries without a direct article URL remain index-verified, not text-verified.
duplicate_policy: Existing 12 pass-one Office entries are referenced, not cloned into the first register. Scriptural psalms are references to reuse.
availability_note: A source-language index does not establish the presence or reuse rights of complete Latin/English/French bodies.
